title: might
summary: **might** + глагол: что-то возможно, но не точно («может быть, возможно»). Используем, когда говорим о планах и событиях, в которых не уверены.
ru:
## Когда используем might
Когда мы **не уверены**, что что-то случится или так и есть, мы говорим **might** («может быть, возможно»).
> I might go to the cinema tonight. — Возможно, я схожу в кино вечером.
> It might rain. — Может пойти дождь.
> She might be at home. — Возможно, она дома.

## Как строится
**might + глагол в начальной форме** (без to, без -s). Для всех лиц форма одна и та же.
> He **might come** to the party. — Он, возможно, придёт на вечеринку.
> They **might be** late. — Они, возможно, опоздают.
Внимание: ~~He mights come.~~ → He **might** come. ~~She might to go.~~ → She might go.

## Уверен или нет?
Сравните «точно» и «возможно»:
> I'm playing tennis tomorrow. — Я играю в теннис завтра. (всё решено)
> I **might** play tennis tomorrow. — Возможно, я сыграю в теннис завтра. (пока не знаю)
> Anna is going to call me. — Анна позвонит мне. (точно)
> Anna **might** call me. — Анна, возможно, позвонит. (не точно)

## Отрицание: might not
**might not** значит «возможно, не…» — это не «нельзя».
> I might not go to work tomorrow. — Возможно, я не пойду завтра на работу.
> Sam might not come. — Сэм, возможно, не придёт.
Краткая форма *mightn't* встречается редко — лучше говорить **might not**.

## Короткий ответ
Можно ответить одним словом **I might.**
> Are you going out tonight? — I might. (= I might go out.)
> Will she say yes? — She might. (= Она, возможно, согласится.)

## might и may
Почти то же самое можно сказать через **may**: I may go = I might go.
> It may snow tomorrow. = It might snow tomorrow.
Но в вопросах **might** не используем: ~~Might you come?~~ → Are you going to come? / Will you come?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I might to be late.~~ → I might **be** late.
- ~~She might comes.~~ → She might **come**.
- ~~Maybe he might to help.~~ → He **might** help. (достаточно одного слова: maybe ИЛИ might)
en:
## When do we use might?
We use **might** when something is possible, but we are not sure. It means "perhaps".
> I might go to the cinema tonight.
> It might rain.
> She might be at home.

## How to make it
**might + base verb** (no to, no -s). The form is the same for every person.
> He **might come** to the party.
> They **might be** late.
Not: ~~He mights come.~~ ~~She might to go.~~

## Sure or not sure?
> I'm playing tennis tomorrow. (it is arranged)
> I **might** play tennis tomorrow. (it is possible)
> Anna is going to call me. (sure)
> Anna **might** call me. (not sure)

## Negative: might not
> I might not go to work tomorrow. (= perhaps I won't go)
> Sam might not come.

## Short answers
> Are you going out tonight? — I might.
> Will she say yes? — She might.

## might and may
You can use **may** in the same way: I may go = I might go.
> It may snow tomorrow. = It might snow tomorrow.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I might to be late.~~ → I might **be** late.
- ~~She might comes.~~ → She might **come**.
structure:
## Утверждение
| Подлежащее | might | Глагол |
|---|---|---|
| I / we / you / they | might | go / play / be |
| he / she / it | might | come / rain / be |

## Отрицание
| Подлежащее | might not | Глагол |
|---|---|---|
| I / we / you / they | might not | go / be |
| he / she / it | might not | come / rain |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + **might (not)** + глагол без to
> We **might go** out. · He **might not know** the answer.

## Важно
- после **might** никогда не ставим **to**, и никогда не добавляем **-s**;
- в вопросе вместо might говорим **Do you think ... will ...?** или **Are you going to ...?**;
- **might** = **may** в значении «возможно»;
- **I might.** — короткий ответ («Возможно.»).

exercises.title: Продолжите предложение с might
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **might** или **might not** и глагол из подсказки.
exercises.example: I'm not sure if he's busy. → He **might be** busy.

items.text: I haven't decided yet. I {{might go|might travel}} to Almaty next week.
The sky is grey. It {{might rain}} later.
I don't know where Dan is. He {{might be}} in the garden.
Take a coat. It {{might be}} cold in the evening.
Kate is very tired. She {{might not come|might not go}} to the party.
We {{might not have}} enough time to visit the museum.

exercises.title: Короткие ответы
exercises.instruction: Ответьте коротко: **I might** или **I might not**, как подсказано в скобках.

items.text: Are you going shopping? — {{I might}}. (возможно, пойду)
Will you stay at home tonight? — {{I might not}}. (возможно, нет)
Is Lisa coming with us? — She {{might}}. (возможно, да)
Do you want to see this film? — {{I might}}. (возможно, да)
Are they going to win the game? — They {{might not}}. (возможно, нет)

exercises.title: Уверен или не уверен
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, который подходит по смыслу.

items.q: I don't know my plans. I ___ visit my aunt on Sunday.
I've bought the tickets. We ___ to Rome on Friday.
items.why: Всё решено, билеты куплены → точный план: **are flying**.
После might — глагол без -s и без to.

items.q: He ___ know the answer. Let's ask him.
Perhaps they will be late. = They ___ late.
Sam isn't sure about the trip. He ___ go.

items.why: might + глагол без -s и без to.

items.q: Какое предложение значит «Я точно играю завтра»?

items.prompt: (we / might / go / to the beach / tomorrow)
answers: We might go to the beach tomorrow.
Tomorrow we might go to the beach.

items.prompt: (they / might not / come / to the meeting)
answers: They might not come to the meeting.
I might buy a new phone.
I might buy a new mobile phone.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте о себе предложениями с **might**. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: What might you do this weekend?
items.sample: I might visit my friends. I might also watch a film.

items.prompt: Where might you go on holiday this year?
items.sample: I might go to the mountains.
I might buy a new bag.

items.prompt: Something you might not do tomorrow
items.sample: I might not get up early.

items.prompt: What might the weather be like tomorrow?
items.sample: It might be sunny, but it might also be windy.
